headline: Recommended approval of no-parking signs on Grafton, Burncoat, Elliot, and East Central streets, plus handicap parking at 72 Richland St.
summary: Members recommended approval of handicap parking, no-parking, crosswalk, stop sign, and truck restriction requests. They recommended holding several others for more information and filing many more. Every vote was 2 to 0, with Ojeda absent.
